This '''mission''' was carried out by the elite [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Lando's Commandos]] shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in an attempt to halt operations by a [[Eiattu pirates|pirate group]] consisting of former [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] [[TIE pilot|pilots]]. The commandos made their way to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Radix]] in the [[Abraxas system/Legends|Abraxas system]], where they were ambushed by [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] forces. Commando [[Tiatkin]] was killed during the attack.

[[File:Lando_in_action.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Pirate forces ambush Lando Calrissian and his commandos]]

Once the commandos were surrounded, the pirate leader, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Harme Kiela]], revealed that the entire operation had been performed to rescue [[Von Asch]], an Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] tactician working in conjunction with Lando's Commandos, and make him their leader. When Asch refused, stating that the pirates had no honor left in them, the pirates attacked once again. [[Kine (pirate)|Kine]], a local [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who betrayed the commandos, produced a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and attempted to kill one of the commandos, [[Isolde Siro]]. Von Asch stepped in front of her, however, and took the brunt of the attack, saving her life. Kine was killed and Asch later recovered. Once New Republic reinforcements arrived, the battle was won by the commandos<ref name="Tales">{{Tales|5|Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings}}</ref> and Kiela was captured, although he later escaped custody.<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|6|Unusual Suspects}}</ref>

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] that the Eiattu pirates mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' are the pirates from ''[[Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings]]'' and that the [[operation on Abraxas]] follows [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] mission to Radix.<ref name="Eiattu pirates" />
